instruction.text: Fill in the correct verb into the gap. Use either simple present or present progressive.

atoms.b:
The Hobby Fair
Next week, our school ((is_organising)) a small hobby fair where students can present their interests. The event ((starts)) on Friday at 12 o’clock.

Everyone ((is_bringing)) something that represents their hobby. When everyone ((gathers)) in the auditorium later, Emma will introduce the program. Until the larger events ((take_place)), the students will share their personal hobbies with each other.
To start off, Antoine and Elisa ((are_introducing)) the arts and crafts club. Some students are bound to ((like)) crafts.
If they ((do)), they will probably join the workshop afterwards. At 4 p.m. the football team ((holds)) an open practice. Before the practice ((begins)), people will be sorted into different teams.
One team is certain to ((win)) while the other looses, such is the game. The final event that ((is_happening)) is a theatre play.
By public demand, the students ((are_playing)) a classic play by Shakespeare. With all these activities during the coming event, the students are bound to ((enjoy)) themselves.
